architecture_decisions.recommendation: Updated documentation formatting to use modern Markdown conventions and improved visual hierarchy
architecture_decisions.rationale: The changes transition from older Markdown formatting (underlines for headers, plain blockquotes) to GitHub-flavored Markdown with callout blocks (`> [!TYPE]`) and proper code block indentation. This improves readability on GitHub and other Markdown renderers that support these features. The use of callout blocks makes warnings and notes more visually distinct.
alternatives_considered: Keeping the original formatting for backward compatibility
Creating separate documentation pages for different sections

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Improved contributor guidelines with clearer instructions and better organization
architecture_decisions.rationale: Restructured the CONTRIBUTING.md to use proper Markdown headers (`#` instead of underlined text) and consistent code block formatting. Updated Go version requirement from 1.18+ to 1.19+ to reflect current project requirements. Added proper spacing between sections and improved code block indentation for better readability in terminal environments.
alternatives_considered: Creating a separate developer documentation site
Keeping minimal documentation to reduce maintenance

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Updated build instructions and project context to be more accurate and helpful
architecture_decisions.rationale: Corrected the path reference from `/examples/base` to `examples/base` (removing leading slash) to be platform-agnostic. Added proper formatting for the build targets list to make it more readable. Moved the Presentator project context into a callout block to visually separate it from general contribution guidelines while keeping the important historical context.
alternatives_considered: Keeping the original formatting but updating content

tickets.title: Update README formatting and content
tickets.description: Improved the main README file with better Markdown formatting, updated warnings to use callout blocks, and reorganized content for better readability

tickets.title: Modernize CONTRIBUTING guidelines
tickets.description: Updated the contributing documentation with proper headers, consistent code formatting, updated Go version requirements, and clearer instructions for contributors

implementation_summary:
The changes focus exclusively on documentation improvements, targeting two key files: README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. The implementation follows a consistent pattern of modernizing Markdown formatting throughout both documents.

In README.md, the most significant change is the transition from traditional blockquote warnings (`> ⚠️`) to GitHub's callout syntax (`> [!WARNING]` and `> [!NOTE]`). This provides better visual distinction in GitHub's interface. The build instructions were also cleaned up with proper code block indentation and the build targets list was formatted for better readability.

CONTRIBUTING.md received more substantial restructuring. The document now uses proper Markdown headers (`# Contributing to PocketBase`) instead of underlined text, creating a cleaner visual hierarchy. Code examples were standardized with consistent indentation (4 spaces for nested code blocks), and the Go version requirement was updated from 1.18+ to 1.19+ to reflect the project's current needs. The instructions for running tests and linters were separated from general text with proper spacing, making them easier to follow.

Both documents maintain technical accuracy while improving approachability. The changes integrate seamlessly with the existing codebase as they only affect documentation files, requiring no changes to the actual Go code, tests, or build processes. The use of modern Markdown features ensures better rendering on GitHub while remaining compatible with other Markdown processors.
